title: Feet-stiffening socks could help you run further for longer | New Scientist
description: The next leap in activewear technology may be socks that squeeze parts of our feet, increasing the efficiency of our gait
author: James Woodford

title: Vibrating mattress helps clear Alzheimer’s protein from the brain | New Scientist
description: Lying on a vibrating mattress for 40 minutes, combined with taking two pills that release nitric oxide into the body, enhanced the clearance of an Alzheimer's-related protein via the brain's waste-disposal system
author: Carissa Wong

title: Inca children were drugged before being sacrificed | New Scientist
description: Analysis of the hair and fingernails of eight mummified Inca children reveals that they were given cocaine and alcohol prior to being sacrificed high on Andean mountain peaks
author: James Woodford

title: Zapping part of the brain makes you think harder – at a cost | New Scientist
description: Stimulating a part of the brain linked to mental effort boosts performance in demanding tasks, but also leads to greater mental fatigue afterwards
author: Michael Le Page

title: Dinosaur red blood cells recovered from 115-million-year-old fossil | New Scientist
description: A bit of leg bone from an Aratasaurus dinosaur fossil collected in Brazil has preserved abundant 3D red blood cells in stunning detail
author: James Woodford

title: COP31: Will this year's climate summit be the most underwhelming ever? | New Scientist
description: Despite coming after a year of dangerous weather and signs that global warming is accelerating, COP31 is unlikely to deliver dramatic progress on climate action
author: Madeleine Cuff
